about: The kind of a document submitted as text, which has no folder to take one from: the tag's `kind` when it names one, else a dashboard when it lists tiles or sets a grid width, else a notebook. The server (submittedTextKind) and the SDK reader (readDashboardDocument with textHeld) each hold the rule, so each side's spec reads this file.

cases.name: no kind and no layout is a notebook
a tag with only a title is a notebook
cases.source:
## artifact { title="x" }
run: q -> { aggregate: c }

cases.name: a tiles list makes a dashboard
a tiles list of only a text tile makes a dashboard
a grid width makes a dashboard
an explicit dashboard wins over the absence of a layout
cases.source:
## artifact { kind=dashboard }
run: q -> { aggregate: c }

cases.name: an explicit notebook wins over a tiles list
